model.title: A resolution designating the week of September 21, 2026, as the "Ray Gaesser Memorial Farm Safety Week" to recognize the life and legacy of Ray Gaesser, who passed away in a tragic farming accident, and promote farm safety in the honor of Ray Gaesser.

summary.text: The resolution would designate the week of September 21, 2026, as "Ray Gaesser Memorial Farm Safety Week" to honor a farmer who died in a farming accident and to promote awareness of farm safety in his memory.
